title: Review-routing table
description: governance/ownership/routing.yml - the path-routing records of T06 #8 d3. Routing yields a set of required independent review classes; all matching routes combine by set union; a more-specific route never erases a stricter matching requirement; every governed path matches an explicit route or fails closed - an uncovered path is a validation error (GOV-ROUTE).

unrouted.description: The fail-closed default, stated explicitly: a governed path matching no route is a validation error, never a permissive fallback (T06 #8 d3/d5).

path.description: Glob-style governed path pattern (** matches across segments; * within one segment).

review_classes.description: The required independent review classes for paths matching this route.

resolution.description: account-delegation: the required class is resolved from the consumed inventory's delegation data (intended_classification) for the <account-name> segment; an unknown, ambiguous, inactive, or otherwise unroutable account is an error, never a permissive fallback (T06 #8 d3; T10 #15 d5).
